ticketNumber.description: Auto-generated on create, e.g. ALT-2026-1001. Null only for legacy rows that predate ticketing.

known.description: Patients with a known value for this indicator.

unknown.description: Patients without a value for this indicator.

coveragePct.description: Known divided by known plus unknown, from 0 to 100.

population.description: Patients included in this indicator denominator.

enrollmentEvents.description: Enrollment records created in the selected period.

cohortPatients.description: Distinct patients with an enrollment created in the selected period.

deceasedPatients.description: Patients marked deceased by date or deactivation reason.

dropoutPatients.description: Inactive cohort patients who are not deceased.

sessions.description: Psycho-oncology appointments scheduled in the selected period, regardless of status.

completionRate.description: Completed sessions divided by all scheduled sessions, from 0 to 100.

gender.description: Top six values; remaining values are combined as Otros.

diagnoses.description: Current diagnosis for cohort patients. Top six values; remaining values are combined as Otros.

treatments.description: Current treatment for cohort patients. Top six values; remaining values are combined as Otros.

cancerStages.description: Current cancer stage for cohort patients. Top six values; remaining values are combined as Otros.

period.description: A Lima calendar day for month periods, or YYYY-MM for year periods.

trend.description: A zero-filled enrollment and session series for the selected period.

hospitals.description: Up to eight hospitals using primary health center, then current medical appointment, treatment, and diagnosis precedence.

regions.description: Up to eight regions using primary health center department, then primary address, then birth department precedence.

referrals.description: Up to eight treatment referral pairs (origin → destination).

replacementDiagnosisId.description: Required when mode is REPLACE; the active diagnosis to retire

clientRef.description: Temporary client reference used to associate enrollment treatments; required for diagnoses[] and omitted only by the legacy diagnosis field

diagnosisRef.description: Temporary clientRef of the diagnosis for this treatment; required when diagnoses[] is used and omitted only for the legacy diagnosis field
